projectDescription: YiPex is a Web3-powered global trade stablecoin settlement platform that enables cross-border trading enterprises to receive, exchange, and pay out funds compliantly using both stablecoins and fiat currencies.
keyFeatures: Stablecoin (USDT/USDC) collection and payment via blockchain networks
Fiat currency receipt through global and local bank accounts
Global payment to 20+ countries via SWIFT and local network
Transfer from crypto wallet to fiat wallet with AML compliance
Trade background document management for KYT/AML compliance
Blockchain address risk verification (free and paid tiers)
Multi-user account management with role-based permissions
Two-factor authentication (2FA) and outgoing payment review controls
publicApiSurface: Fiat collection (global and local bank accounts)
Stablecoin payment to external blockchain address
Global payment via SWIFT or local network
Transfer from crypto wallet to fiat wallet
Trade document creation and management (buyer/seller orders)
Recipient management (crypto and fiat payees, withdrawal accounts)
Security settings (login password, transaction password, 2FA, outgoing review)
